chunks: When you look around, you will see delights and great dominion.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to see delights and great dominion when looking around?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transformative power of spiritual insight (basirah), where the believer perceives the hidden sovereignty of God in the natural world. It connects the external observation of creation with the internal realization of divine grace, reflecting the concept that true 'delight' arises from recognizing Allah's presence in all things.
